oczekiwana_odpowiedz: The messy parts of the functions are irrelevant. All that matters for intersection is whether $f(x)-g(x)=0$. As $g(x)-f(x)=x^3-5x^2-8x+12=(x-6)(x+2)(x-1)$, the largest value of $x$ at which the graphs intersect is $x=\boxed{6}$.

$g(x) = C(x) + 4x^3 - 11x^2 - 6x + 13$

Setting $f(x) = g(x)$ leads to:

We can test small integer values using the Rational Root Theorem:

$x^2 - 4x - 12 = (x - 6)(x + 2)$
